verdict.rationale: Rainforest's marketing page lists 'chargebacks' among its pre-built embeddable components alongside payments and onboarding, implying dispute handling is part of the platform, but no docs detail per-sub-merchant chargeback routing, evidence submission workflows (API or dashboard), or how outcomes reconcile against seller balances. missing for 10: dedicated chargeback/dispute API or webhook docs, evidence submission endpoint details, sub-merchant-level routing confirmation, and balance-adjustment mechanics.
